name: lena_fischer
title: Senior Frontend Engineer
job_desc:
Senior Frontend Engineer - Brightloop (Denver, Hybrid)
Brightloop makes analytics software for operations teams. We want a senior frontend engineer to lead our web app's architecture.
You will: build complex data-heavy UIs in React and TypeScript; own and grow our design system in Storybook; improve web performance (Core Web Vitals); make the product accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA); set testing standards with Jest and Playwright; mentor other frontend engineers.
Requirements: 5+ years frontend; expert React and TypeScript; design systems; performance and accessibility experience; Next.js and GraphQL a plus.

interview.question: Tell me about a time you improved the performance of a web app.
interview.answer: At Peakline the dashboard was slow so I worked on making it faster. I did some code splitting and it loaded faster after.
